The '''Koaan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koaan]].
